# `fnox lease`

- **Usage:** `fnox lease <SUBCOMMAND>`

Manage ephemeral credential leases

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Subcommands

- [`fnox lease cleanup`](/cli/lease/cleanup.md)
- [`fnox lease create [FLAGS] [BACKEND_NAME]`](/cli/lease/create.md)
- [`fnox lease list [--active] [--expired]`](/cli/lease/list.md)
- [`fnox lease revoke <LEASE_ID>`](/cli/lease/revoke.md)

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Create and manage temporary credentials from configured lease backends. fnox exec can create or reuse a lease automatically.

```sh
fnox lease list --active
fnox exec -- aws s3 ls
```
